name: ppyong
description: 뿅 — 공원에서 두더지를 잡는 iOS 게임

scripts.build:www: npm run build:native && rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/assets && cp index.html game.js styles.css privacy.html apple-native.js www/ && cp -R assets/. www/assets/
scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios && bash scripts/apply-app-icon.sh && bash scripts/register-apple-plugin.sh
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
